segments.text: Hello and welcome to this massive open online course, Introduction to BioRisk Management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习这门大规模开放在线课程“生物风险管理导论”。

segments.text: I am your instructor Kenneth, and in this segment we will be discussing about samples
segments.zh: 我是你们的讲师Kenneth，在这一部分中，我们将讨论样本，

segments.text: and specifically referring to hospital derived samples.
segments.zh: 特别是来自医院的样本。

segments.text: Now in your role as a laboratory technician in a biosafety level 3 laboratory, you will
segments.zh: 作为生物安全三级实验室的一名实验室技术人员，你

segments.text: be required to analyze samples from different locations.
segments.zh: 需要分析来自不同地方的样本。

segments.text: Samples which are derived from researchers which consist of exonic opeocultures are easy
segments.zh: 来自研究人员的样本由无菌纯培养物组成，比较容易

segments.text: to analyze because the risk can be assessed very easily.
segments.zh: 分析，因为其风险很容易评估。

segments.text: We are aware of the biological agent and we are also aware of any modifications which have
segments.zh: 我们清楚是哪种生物因子，也清楚对该生物因子

segments.text: been made to that biological agent.
segments.zh: 做过的任何改造。

segments.text: The situation changes slightly when we have to analyze samples derived from patients.
segments.zh: 而当我们需要分析来自患者的样本时，情况就有些不同了。

segments.text: These may be in the form of swabs, serum samples, blood, urine or stools.
segments.zh: 这些样本可能是拭子、血清样本、血液、尿液或粪便。

segments.text: When samples are received from hospitals, they may consist of more than one biological agent
segments.zh: 从医院收到的样本，单个样本中可能含有

segments.text: within a single sample.
segments.zh: 不止一种生物因子。

segments.text: How do we address this risk?
segments.zh: 我们该如何应对这种风险呢？

segments.text: So in the case of hospital samples, we assume the highest possible risk.
segments.zh: 因此，对于医院样本，我们按最高可能的风险来对待。

segments.text: Now when samples are received from hospitals, they will be shipped in a special packing
segments.zh: 从医院收到的样本会用专门的包装

segments.text: container.
segments.zh: 容器运送。

segments.text: This is an example of a bag in which the sample will be shipped and this bag will
segments.zh: 这是一个运送样本用的袋子的例子，这个袋子会

segments.text: be sealed, it will be locked with a tie and then shipped in a container which may contain
segments.zh: 被密封，用扎带扎紧，然后放入容器中运送，容器里可能装有

segments.text: ice or some other refrigerant such as carbon dioxide, CO2 ice, what we call as dry ice.
segments.zh: 冰或其他制冷剂，比如二氧化碳、CO2冰，也就是我们所说的干冰。

segments.text: Okay so when you receive these samples, the first thing which you need to do is to ensure
segments.zh: 好，收到这些样本后，首先要做的是确保

segments.text: that the outer packing material is thoroughly sterilized with a sterilant.
segments.zh: 用消毒剂对外包装材料进行彻底消毒。

segments.text: In our case we use 70% ethanol, we wait for around 30 seconds and we open the bag after
segments.zh: 我们这里用的是70%乙醇，等待大约30秒，30秒后

segments.text: 30 seconds.
segments.zh: 再打开袋子。

segments.text: The 30 second period is known as the contact time.
segments.zh: 这30秒的时间称为接触时间。

segments.text: Once you have opened your bag, you will obtain the sample, I am going to take out
segments.zh: 打开袋子后，就可以取出样本，我现在从这个袋子里

segments.text: a sample from this bag.
segments.zh: 取出一份样本。

segments.text: The sample will be generally shipped in a tube like this.
segments.zh: 样本一般会装在这样的管子里运送。

segments.text: This is a sample containing tube, I cannot reveal the details of the patient as this
segments.zh: 这是一支装有样本的管子，因为这是来自患者的样本，

segments.text: is a patient derived sample.
segments.zh: 我不能透露患者的详细信息。

segments.text: Now this sample is basically a serum sample you can see in the tube and you can note
segments.zh: 这份样本基本上是血清样本，大家可以在管中看到，还可以注意到

segments.text: that there is a small ward of bandage over here.
segments.zh: 这里有一小团纱布。

segments.text: Now there is a purpose for this specific ward of bandage here.
segments.zh: 这一小团纱布放在这里是有特定用途的。

segments.text: So when I open the sample in the biological safety cabinet, any of the serum which drips
segments.zh: 当我在生物安全柜中打开样本时，从这支管子里滴出的

segments.text: from this particular tube will be trapped by this ward.
segments.zh: 任何血清都会被这团纱布吸住。

segments.text: It will not spill onto my gloves and cause a breach of containment.
segments.zh: 血清不会溅到我的手套上，造成防护失效。

segments.text: So this is one of the key aspects of transporting samples from hospitals.
segments.zh: 这是从医院运送样本的关键环节之一。

segments.text: They must be accompanied with the proper transport security.
segments.zh: 样本运送必须有适当的运输安全保障。

segments.text: Now the technician who has drawn the sample or the doctor at the hospital has to ensure
segments.zh: 采集样本的技术人员或医院的医生必须确保

segments.text: that the sample is properly labeled and properly bagged so as to ensure that the transport
segments.zh: 样本正确贴标签、正确装袋，以确保运输

segments.text: agent or the one who transport the sample to the hospital as well as the technician
segments.zh: 人员，也就是把样本运送到医院的人，以及在实验室工作的

segments.text: who works in the laboratory is basically protected from the biological agent.
segments.zh: 技术人员，基本上都能免受生物因子的危害。

segments.text: Now what happens when the samples come into our lab?
segments.zh: 那么样本进入我们实验室后会怎样处理呢？

segments.text: Basically there are two types of samples which come in, the first in which we have to culture
segments.zh: 基本上进来的样本有两类，第一类是需要培养

segments.text: the biological agent.
segments.zh: 生物因子的样本。

segments.text: So in that case we practice the extreme set of precautions and we assess the risk in
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们采取最严格的一套防范措施，并按

segments.text: terms of a live culture.
segments.zh: 活培养物来评估风险。

segments.text: So the sample for instance bacterial samples may need to be transferred onto media.
segments.zh: 例如，细菌样本可能需要转接到培养基上。

segments.text: In the case of serum samples which got to be analyzed for instance nucleic acids or
segments.zh: 而对于需要分析的血清样本，比如分析核酸，或者

segments.text: in this case we are analyzing samples from COVID-19 patients or suspected patients.
segments.zh: 在本例中，我们分析的是来自COVID-19患者或疑似患者的样本，

segments.text: We move on to the next step which is inactivation of the sample.
segments.zh: 我们会进入下一步，也就是样本灭活。

segments.text: Now for inactivation of the samples we have to follow the standard operating procedure
segments.zh: 样本灭活必须遵循针对该特定生物因子的

segments.text: for that particular biological agent.
segments.zh: 标准操作规程。

segments.text: In this case of COVID-19 it involves elevating the sample to a temperature of 60 to 70 degrees
segments.zh: 对于COVID-19，需要在加热模块中把样本加热到60到70度，

segments.text: in a thermal block and after a period of one hour the sample is basically inactivated.
segments.zh: 一小时后，样本基本上就被灭活了。

segments.text: Now remember that all these procedures must be conducted within a biological safety cabinet
segments.zh: 请记住，所有这些操作都必须在生物安全柜内进行，

segments.text: with the appropriate PPEs and in accordance with the administrative procedures or administrative
segments.zh: 穿戴适当的个人防护装备，并遵守管理程序或管理

segments.text: controls.
segments.zh: 控制措施。

segments.text: Once the sample is inactivated we can process to the next step which is the extraction
segments.zh: 样本灭活后，就可以进行下一步，即提取

segments.text: of the nucleic acid which must also be conducted in a biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 核酸，这一步也必须在生物安全柜内进行。

segments.text: Once the nucleic acid is extracted the sample is ready for processing which in terms of the
segments.zh: 核酸提取完成后，样本就可以进行处理，也就是

segments.text: analysis.
segments.zh: 分析了。

segments.text: So in our case for COVID-19 we use a thermal cycler, a real time thermal cycler which will
segments.zh: 对于COVID-19，我们使用热循环仪，也就是实时荧光定量热循环仪，它会

segments.text: analyze the sample for the specific biological agent.
segments.zh: 检测样本中是否存在特定的生物因子。

segments.text: Now all these aspects need to be integrated into your sample preparation strategy.
segments.zh: 所有这些方面都需要纳入你的样本制备策略中。

segments.text: You must assess the risk of the procedure itself.
segments.zh: 你必须评估操作程序本身的风险。

segments.text: So coming back to what we have learned, we have a risk assessment.
segments.zh: 回到我们所学的内容，我们要进行风险评估。

segments.text: So we assess the risk both by the biological agent, in the case of a sample from hospital
segments.zh: 我们根据生物因子来评估风险，对于来自医院患者的样本，

segments.text: patients we assume the highest risk, we then apply the specific controls.
segments.zh: 我们按最高风险对待，然后采取具体的控制措施。

segments.text: So in this case I am in a biological safety level 3 laboratory and I am applying the pertinent
segments.zh: 在本例中，我身处生物安全三级实验室，正在采取相应的

segments.text: engineering controls as well as the personal protective equipment which I am wearing and
segments.zh: 工程控制措施，以及我所穿戴的个人防护装备，还有

segments.text: the engineering controls which is this unit itself.
segments.zh: 工程控制措施，也就是这台设备本身。

segments.text: These are some of the key points which we need to take into consideration when managing
segments.zh: 这些是在管理来自已知和未知样本的生物因子时

segments.text: biological agents arrive from known as well as unknown samples.
segments.zh: 需要考虑的一些要点。

segments.text: Thank you very much for watching this short segment.
segments.zh: 非常感谢观看这一小段内容。

segments.text: I will discuss further in my lecture.
segments.zh: 我会在讲座中进一步讨论。

segments.text: In the meantime, stay bio safe.
segments.zh: 在此期间，请注意生物安全。
